title: Nailing down the Hubble constant value through time delay cosmography: A 3% measurement from SN Refsdal
comment: 8 pages, 4 figues, 1 table; submitted to A&A
summary: We present the first inference of the Hubble constant and matter density parameter from a strongly lensed supernova (SN) by exploiting the mass model of a galaxy cluster enhanced by an extended surface brightness reconstruction. This has resulted in the most precise H0 measurement from a single strong lens so far, outperforming the 3.9% result from the lensed quasar DES J048-5354. Building upon the mass model of MACS J1149.5+2223 relying on image positions only, we incorporate the surface brightness distribution of the SN Refsdal host, to infer some cosmological parameter values within a flat LCDM framework. We consider two cosmological parameterizations, with either H0 and $Ω_m$ or H0 alone treated as free parameters. We explore four different mass-model realizations to assess some of the systematic uncertainties associated with the constraint weighting and source reconstruction. Although known as one of the main systematic effects, we deliberately keep the cluster total mass parametrization fixed to that of the previously published point-like mass model to enable a fair comparison. This reveals that incorporating 77,000 HST pixels reduces the uncertainty on the inferred value of H0 by a factor of 2.0. Our final measurements are $H_0=65.0^{+2.0}_{-1.8}$ km/s/Mpc and $Ω_m=0.30^{+0.08}_{-0.09}$, in agreement with previous results from lensed SNe. This corresponds to a substantially improved precision, reaching a remarkable 3.0% uncertainty on the value of H0. The contributions of the uncertainties on the lens total mass and on the measured time delays to the final H0 error are now comparable, indicating that future improvements will depend on more precise time-delay measurements and continued control of systematic effects. With sub-percent time-delay values reachable at cluster-scale, this mass model approach has the power to lead to unprecedentedly precise H0 measurements.

AI.tldr: 利用强透镜超新星与星系团质量模型结合延展表面亮度重建，首次从单一强透镜系统测得3.0%精度的哈勃常数。
AI.motivation: 此前单强透镜系统的H0测量精度有限（如透镜类星体DES J048-5354为3.9%），需要提升精度并评估系统误差，以检验宇宙学参数。
AI.method: 基于MACS J1149.5+2223的质心位置质量模型，引入SN Refsdal宿主星系表面亮度分布（77,000个HST像素），在平坦LCDM框架下考虑两种参数化（H0与Ωm或仅H0自由），并探索四种质量模型实现以评估系统误差。
AI.result: H0=65.0+2.0/-1.8 km/s/Mpc，Ωm=0.30+0.08/-0.09；H0不确定度较仅用像位置提升2倍，达到3.0%精度；透镜总质量与时间延迟测量误差对H0的贡献相当。
AI.conclusion: 该质量模型方法可显著提升单强透镜系统H0测量精度，未来需更精确的时间延迟测量与系统误差控制，有望实现前所未有的H0精度。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 我们首次通过利用扩展表面亮度重建增强的星系团质量模型，从强透镜超新星（SN）推断哈勃常数和物质密度参数。这产生了迄今为止从单一强透镜获得的最精确的H0测量，优于透镜类星体DES J048-5354的3.9%结果。基于仅依赖图像位置的MACS J1149.5+2223质量模型，我们纳入SN Refsdal宿主的表面亮度分布，在平坦LCDM框架内推断一些宇宙学参数值。我们考虑两种宇宙学参数化，其中H0和$Ω_m$或仅H0被视为自由参数。我们探索四种不同的质量模型实现，以评估与约束加权和源重建相关的一些系统不确定性。尽管已知是主要系统效应之一，我们故意将星系团总质量参数化固定为先前发表的类点质量模型，以便进行公平比较。这表明纳入77,000个HST像素将推断的H0值的不确定性降低了2.0倍。我们的最终测量结果为$H_0=65.0^{+2.0}_{-1.8}$ km/s/Mpc和$Ω_m=0.30^{+0.08}_{-0.09}$，与先前透镜超新星的结果一致。这对应于显著提高的精度，达到H0值3.0%的不确定性。透镜总质量和测量时间延迟的不确定性对最终H0误差的贡献现在相当，表明未来的改进将取决于更精确的时间延迟测量和持续控制系统效应。在星系团尺度上可实现亚百分比时间延迟值的情况下，这种质量模型方法有能力导致前所未有的精确H0测量。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于可用摘要：该质量模型方法可显著提升单强透镜系统H0测量精度，未来需更精确的时间延迟测量与系统误差控制，有望实现前所未有的H0精度。

figures.caption_en: Figure 1 : Top: Color-color plot of all 77,000 HST pixels used for the source surface brightness reconstruction. Red crosses represent the 798 pixels slightly contaminated by the light from some cluster members ( \(\sim 1\%\) ), while the color positions of the other pixels are shown in blue. To mitigate the remaining cluster light contamination, the corresponding uncertainties are now boosted by a factor of 10. Bottom: Spatial distribution of the pixels containing some residual cluster light following the same color coding as above with the HST F606W image in the background.
figures.caption_zh: 图1：顶部：用于源表面亮度重建的所有77,000个HST像素的颜色-颜色图。红色十字代表798个像素，受到一些星系团成员的光轻微污染（\(\sim 1\%\)），而其他像素的颜色位置以蓝色显示。为了减轻剩余的星系团光污染，相应的不确定性现在被放大了10倍。底部：包含一些残余星系团光的像素的空间分布，遵循与上述相同的颜色编码，背景为HST F606W图像。

figures.caption_en: Table 1 : Cosmological values from the final chains.

Figure 2 : 2D contour plots (1 \(\sigma\) and 2 \(\sigma\) ) and normalized histograms of the two inferred cosmological parameters \(H_{0}\) and \(\Omega_{\text{m}}\) . The top panel shows the results from the point-like mass models S24 and from those excluding the knots of the SN host, while the bottom panel shows those from S24 and from those with the SN host knots. Here w and wo are abbreviations for Ew + Sw and Ewo + Swo , respectively. The impact from incorporating the source surface brightness distribution is clearly evident.
figures.caption_zh: 图2：两个推断的宇宙学参数\(H_{0}\)和\(\Omega_{\text{m}}\)的2D等高线图（1 \(\sigma\)和2 \(\sigma\)）和归一化直方图。顶部面板显示了来自类点质量模型S24和排除SN宿主节点的结果，而底部面板显示了来自S24和包含SN宿主节点的结果。这里w和wo分别是Ew + Sw和Ewo + Swo的缩写。纳入源表面亮度分布的影响显而易见。

figures.caption_en: Figure 3 : Measured values of the Hubble constant from this work compared to the literature. Results from lensed SNe with only varying \(H_{0}\) are shown in orange, while those with more flexible cosmological model are in red. Our results from SN Refsdal are well in agreement with previous results on the same system ( Kelly et al., 2023b ; Grillo et al., 2024 ) , as well as the values inferred from the CMB ( Planck Collaboration: Aghanim et al., 2020 , brown,) , the Chicago-Carnegie Hubble Program ( Freedman et al., 2025 , CCHP) , and the SN Encore ( Pierel et al., 2026 ; Suyu et al., 2026 ) and SN Winny systems ( Mörtsell et al., 2026 ) .
figures.caption_zh: 图3：本工作测量的哈勃常数值与文献的比较。仅变化\(H_{0}\)的透镜超新星结果以橙色显示，而具有更灵活宇宙学模型的结果以红色显示。我们从SN Refsdal得到的结果与同一系统的先前结果（Kelly et al., 2023b; Grillo et al., 2024）以及从CMB（Planck Collaboration: Aghanim et al., 2020，棕色）、芝加哥-卡内基哈勃计划（Freedman et al., 2025，CCHP）、SN Encore（Pierel et al., 2026; Suyu et al., 2026）和SN Winny系统（Mörtsell et al., 2026）推断的值非常一致。

figures.caption_en: Figure 4 : Redshift distribution for families 6, 7 and 8 predicted by the models S24 (H0+om), S24 (H0), Ewo (Ho+om) and Swo (H0+om) as representative examples. The redshift of family 6 is now confirmed by JWST to be at \(z_{\text{spec}}=2.7927\) ( Sarrouh et al., 2026 ) , as indicated by the black line.
figures.caption_zh: 图4：模型S24 (H0+om)、S24 (H0)、Ewo (Ho+om)和Swo (H0+om)作为代表性示例预测的家族6、7和8的红移分布。家族6的红移现在由JWST确认在\(z_{\text{spec}}=2.7927\)（Sarrouh et al., 2026），如黑线所示。
